content: {"paper_id":"W3207000850","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","exact_quote":"In partial label learning, a multi-class classifier is learned from the ambiguous supervision where each training example is associated with a set of candidate labels among which only one is valid.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确以偏标记学习为研究任务：每个训练样本对应一组候选标签且仅一个有效，并在此设定下学习多类分类器。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"ambiguous supervision where each training example is associated with a set of candidate labels among which only one is valid","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"候选标签集合且仅一个为真属于不精确的监督信号，论文将该歧义监督作为核心学习问题。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"the proposed approach jointly performs adaptive graph construction, candidate label disambiguation and predictive model induction with alternating optimization","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文提出自适应图构建并与消歧、模型归纳联合优化，即学习/修正样本间图结构，而非仅使用固定图。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"a novel partial label learning approach based on adaptive graph guided disambiguation is proposed, which is shown to be more effective in revealing the intrinsic manifold structure among training examples","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"自适应图引导消歧旨在揭示训练样本的内在流形结构，并用图结构约束/引导标签置信度学习，满足图与流形正则化定义。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","reason_zh":"摘要提到候选标签消歧与预测模型归纳交替优化，但未明确说明模型对弱标注样本的预测被作为后续训练信号，无法确认伪标签或自训练机制。"}],"input_issues":[]}
